ownRead.statement:
### E03 — Fu et al. (2023)

**Mechanochemical feedback loop drives persistent motion of liposomes**  
Nature Physics 19, 1211–1218. DOI: [10.1038/s41567-023-02058-8](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-023-02058-8)

**Classification:** supports core / domain-specific realization.  
**Evidence:** Experiment plus reduced mechanochemical model.  
**Existing clauses:** §3, §4, §5.

Protein distributions deform vesicles; deformation and motion reorganize the proteins, sustaining a reciprocal loop.

**Scope:** Reconstituted lipid/protein system with ATP; the simulation uses a phenomenological movement coupling.

**Checked:** Full primary article, methods and figure descriptions.  
**Location:** Figures 1–4; Extended Data Figures 6–8; Results on geometry-sensitive protein redistribution.  
**Inspected source:** https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-023-02058-8
